positioning: Product of the Mountains — authentic Italian Alpine cheese, made at altitude (above 600 m), since 1925.

logos.note: Green oval with cow + mountain-M wordmark + 'Formaggi & Tradizione'. The logo carries its own green background; place on cream or white, not on busy art.

italiaRed.role: Italian-flag ribbon on logo ONLY — never a layout color

colorRules: Cream backgrounds with green typography — never the reverse for body copy.
Forest Green for headlines + logo backgrounds; Italia Green only as a heritage accent.
Italia Red is reserved for the logo ribbon. Never use it as a UI/layout color.

ui.use: UI, buttons, forms, nav — every actionable element; 700 UPPERCASE +0.04em for buttons

type.ratio: ~65% Cora italic / 30% Futura PT 700 / 5% Futura PT Bold/Condensed
type.note: Cora + Futura PT are Adobe Typekit (kit med2peg) — load on the real domain; web substitutes (Newsreader/Jost) are used where Typekit can't serve.

voice.leadHook: Lead with mountain / altitude / Alpine — not generic "Italian".
avoidWords: innovative (alone — pair as 'we innovate by tradition')
voice.do: The opening chapter of our history is written in 1925 by grandfather Florindo…
voice.dont: Founded in 1925, Monti Trentini is a leading premium cheese brand…
